$comment: Shared project settings, TRACKED so every machine gets them.
This is the PUBLIC distribution repo: README and licence only. Builds
are published as release assets and never committed here, and the
add-on source lives in the private repo -- so the build and install
scripts allowed there are deliberately absent, because neither exists
These entries remove the permission PROMPT. They do not make Claude
push on its own -- it still acts when asked. Force pushes, hard resets
and history rewrites are denied rather than merely absent: this repo is
public, so a rewritten history is visible to anyone who already cloned
it and cannot be quietly undone.
